desc: The SABRE Pepper Spray with Quick Grip New User Kit provides maximum strength personal protection with advanced aiming control - perfect for both beginners and experienced users. It features a patented ergonomic P-shaped holder that instantly aligns with your index finger for easy aiming. Finger grooves, a concave thumb rest, and a stream channel ensure a secure, comfortable grip. Safety features like a twist-lock, protective hood, and locking clip help prevent accidental discharge. Internal supports and an anti-rotation boss keep the canister securely in place. A keychain attachment allows quick access on the go, making it ideal for runners, commuters, students, and everyday carry. Compact, powerful, and simple to use - this is personal safety from SABRE, the #1 trusted pepper spray brand.
